A Letter for Karis

For Karis
tap to open ♡
“

8 September 2026

My dear pretty girl ❤️

It's easy to stand by someone when everything is sunshine and smooth sailing. But staying through the heavy days — when mistakes happen, when life gets messy, and when we aren't at our absolute best — that's where real love proves itself. Loving someone through their flaws, their doubts, and their lowest moments is a far deeper, more beautiful kind of love than just enjoying the easy parts.

Thank you for choosing to love me through both: the absolute best days and the hardest ones. Thank you for holding my hand when I feel lost, for accepting every piece of who I am, and for constantly inspiring me to grow. Your patience, your forgiveness, and your grace mean more to me than words can ever really express.

I am endlessly grateful that you are mine, and I am so proud to be yours. Just as you've loved every side of me, I love every single version of you — on the high days, the quiet days, and everything in between. You are my partner, my best friend, and my future. I'm not going anywhere, and I'm never letting you go.

Mwaahhh

Yours and only yours

Dummy ❤️

Reasons Why I Love You

Just a few of the million reasons you're special

  • ★You listen to understand, not just to answer.
  • ★The exact look on your face right before you start laughing.
  • ★You hold space for my thoughts even when they're half-formed.
  • ★The way you make ordinary places feel like somewhere worth staying.
  • ★You never make me feel silly for caring deeply about small things.
  • ★You make the quiet hours feel full instead of lonely.
  • ★Being around you feels like coming home.
  • ★You let me ramble about things you don't even care about.
  • ★You are remarkably patient with me, even when I'm indecisive.
  • ★Loving you is the easiest choice I make every single day.
